post_text:
@Hilton Honors members can now pay hotel charges with points at digital check-out, starting in 150 US hotels.

The feature, announced on 21 October, is open to Silver, Gold, Diamond and Diamond Reserve members through the app. @Hilton expects more than 800 hotels by the end of 2026, and more than 6,000 in the US and Canada in early 2027.

Until now, points mostly paid for the room. Here, they can cover what guests spend on site.

The signal: loyalty points are becoming a payment method. For a hotel, that changes how restaurant, bar and spa revenue is settled, and who funds it.

Would you let your guests pay for dinner in points?

Read the full article: https://hospitality-signals.com/signal-of-the-week/2026-10-21-hilton-pay-with-points/

#LuxuryHospitality #HotelLoyalty #HotelDistribution
